source.check: the three divisions and names read from the Frontier Sentinel's 'Newry No. 1 Rural Council' nominations report (29 April 1933, p. 5)

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Only three candidates were nominated for the fourteen divisions; all the other outgoing members were automatically returned (deemed re-elected) and there were no contests. The members deemed re-elected are added with their divisions inferred from the 1930 return, placed on the council by the new council's annual meeting (30 May 1933) or, for Ballycoshone, Clonduff, Crobane and Rathfriland North and South, by meeting reports of June-October 1933 (round2-down, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
